title: [BUG] [BigQuery] Missing `dbt0104: dangling comma detected` warning
body:
**Describe the bug**

https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/13748 mentions how dangling commas will yield a warning in Databricks and Redshift. But when reproducing that issue, noticed that Snowflake and BigQuery do not have that warning.

**What version of dbt Fusion is this bug in? (find out by running `dbt --version`)**

**Is this a discrepancy between the dbt Fusion Engine and dbt Core? Check one.**
- [ ] YES
- [x] NO

**To Reproduce**
1. Open [this workspace](https://github.com/dbt-labs/scratch/tree/main/repros/fusion-750)
2. Follow the instructions in the README

TLDR: `dbtf compile` a model with a trailing comma like this:

```
with processing as (

    select
        1 as id,
        1 as rounds,
        1 as players,  -- Trailing comma here causes error

)

select * from processing
```

**Expected behavior**
Expected see a `dangling comma detected` warning.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.

**Operating System and CPU Type (please complete the following information):**
* Mac/Windows/Linux?
* X86 or ARM?

comments.author: findepi
comments.body: Not sure whether we want a warning. It's OK to be opinionated if we choose so. @eliasdefaria

comments.author: eliasdefaria
comments.body: I believe this is something the linter should handle with a configurable rule, agree @findepi?
